verses.Genesis 1:1: In the beginning, God created everything: the heavens above and the earth below. Here’s what happened:
verses.Joshua 1:9: This is My command: be strong and courageous. Never be afraid or discouraged because I am your God, the Eternal One, and I will remain with you wherever you go.
verses.Psalm 23:1: The Eternal is my shepherd, He cares for me always.
verses.Psalm 27:1: The Eternal is my light amidst my darkness and my rescue in times of trouble. So whom shall I fear? He surrounds me with a fortress of protection. So nothing should cause me alarm.
verses.Psalm 46:10: “Be still, be calm, see, and understand I am the True God. I am honored among all the nations. I am honored over all the earth.”
verses.Psalm 119:105: Your word is a lamp for my steps; it lights the path before me.
verses.Proverbs 3:5-6: Place your trust in the Eternal; rely on Him completely; never depend upon your own ideas and inventions. Give Him the credit for everything you accomplish, and He will smooth out and straighten the road that lies ahead.
verses.Isaiah 40:31: But those who trust in the Eternal One will regain their strength. They will soar on wings as eagles. They will run—never winded, never weary. They will walk—never tired, never faint.
verses.Isaiah 41:10: So don’t be afraid. I am here, with you; don’t be dismayed, for I am your God. I will strengthen you, help you. I am here with My right hand to make right and to hold you up.
verses.Isaiah 53:5: But he was hurt because of us; he suffered so. Our wrongdoing wounded and crushed him. He endured the breaking that made us whole. The injuries he suffered became our healing.
verses.Jeremiah 29:11: For I know the plans I have for you,” says the Eternal, “plans for peace, not evil, to give you a future and hope—never forget that.
verses.Lamentations 3:22-23: How enduring is God’s loyal love; the Eternal has inexhaustible compassion. Here they are, every morning, new! Your faithfulness, God, is as broad as the day.
verses.Micah 6:8: No. He has told you, mortals, what is good in His sight. What else does the Eternal ask of you But to live justly and to love kindness and to walk with your True God in all humility?
verses.Matthew 6:33: Seek first the kingdom of God and His righteousness, and then all these things will be given to you too.
verses.Matthew 11:28-30: Come to Me, all who are weary and burdened, and I will give you rest. Put My yoke upon your shoulders—it might appear heavy at first, but it is perfectly fitted to your curves. Learn from Me, for I am gentle and humble of heart. When you are yoked to Me, your weary souls will find rest. For My yoke is easy, and My burden is light.
verses.Matthew 28:19-20: Go out and make disciples in all the nations. Ceremonially wash them through baptism in the name of the triune God: Father, Son, and Holy Spirit. Then disciple them. Form them in the practices and postures that I have taught you, and show them how to follow the commands I have laid down for you. And I will be with you, day after day, to the end of the age.
verses.Luke 1:37: So the impossible is possible with God.
verses.John 1:1: Before time itself was measured, the Voice was speaking. The Voice was and is God.
verses.John 3:16: For God expressed His love for the world in this way: He gave His only Son so that whoever believes in Him will not face everlasting destruction, but will have everlasting life.
verses.John 8:32: you will know the truth, and that truth will give you freedom.
verses.John 10:10: The thief approaches with malicious intent, looking to steal, slaughter, and destroy; I came to give life with joy and abundance.
verses.John 11:25-26: Jesus: I am the resurrection and the source of all life; those who believe in Me will live even in death. Everyone who lives and believes in Me will never truly die. Do you believe this?
verses.John 14:6: Jesus: I am the path, the truth, and the energy of life. No one comes to the Father except through Me.
verses.Acts 1:8: Here’s the knowledge you need: you will receive power when the Holy Spirit comes on you. And you will be My witnesses, first here in Jerusalem, then beyond to Judea and Samaria, and finally to the farthest places on earth.
verses.Romans 3:23: You see, all have sinned, and all their futile attempts to reach God in His glory fail.
verses.Romans 5:8: But think about this: while we were wasting our lives in sin, God revealed His powerful love to us in a tangible display—the Anointed One died for us.
verses.Romans 6:23: The payoff for a life of sin is death, but God is offering us a free gift—eternal life through our Lord Jesus, the Anointed One, the Liberating King.
verses.Romans 8:28: We are confident that God is able to orchestrate everything to work toward something good and beautiful when we love Him and accept His invitation to live according to His plan.
verses.Romans 10:9: So if you believe deep in your heart that God raised Jesus from the pit of death and if you voice your allegiance by confessing the truth that “Jesus is Lord,” then you will be saved!
verses.Romans 12:1-2: Brothers and sisters, in light of all I have shared with you about God’s mercies, I urge you to offer your bodies as a living and holy sacrifice to God, a sacred offering that brings Him pleasure; this is your reasonable, essential worship. Do not allow this world to mold you in its own image. Instead, be transformed from the inside out by renewing your mind. As a result, you will be able to discern what God wills and whatever God finds good, pleasing, and complete.
verses.1 Corinthians 10:13: Any temptation you face will be nothing new. But God is faithful, and He will not let you be tempted beyond what you can handle. But He always provides a way of escape so that you will be able to endure and keep moving forward.
verses.1 Corinthians 13:4-7: Love is patient; love is kind. Love isn’t envious, doesn’t boast, brag, or strut about. There’s no arrogance in love; it’s never rude, crude, or indecent—it’s not self-absorbed. Love isn’t easily upset. Love doesn’t tally wrongs or celebrate injustice; but truth—yes, truth—is love’s delight! Love puts up with anything and everything that comes along; it trusts, hopes, and endures no matter what.
verses.2 Corinthians 5:17: Therefore, if anyone is united with the Anointed One, that person is a new creation. The old life is gone—and see—a new life has begun!
verses.Galatians 5:22-23: The Holy Spirit produces a different kind of fruit: unconditional love, joy, peace, patience, kindheartedness, goodness, faithfulness, gentleness, and self-control. You won’t find any law opposed to fruit like this.
verses.Ephesians 2:8-9: For it’s by God’s grace that you have been saved. You receive it through faith. It was not our plan or our effort. It is God’s gift, pure and simple. You didn’t earn it, not one of us did, so don’t go around bragging that you must have done something amazing.
verses.Philippians 4:6-7: Don’t be anxious about things; instead, pray. Pray about everything. He longs to hear your requests, so talk to God about your needs and be thankful for what has come. And know that the peace of God (a peace that is beyond any and all of our human understanding) will stand watch over your hearts and minds in Jesus, the Anointed One.
verses.Philippians 4:13: I can be content in any and every situation through the Anointed One who is my power and strength.
verses.2 Timothy 1:7: You see, God did not give us a cowardly spirit but a powerful, loving, and disciplined spirit.
verses.2 Timothy 3:16-17: All of Scripture is God-breathed; in its inspired voice, we hear useful teaching, rebuke, correction, instruction, and training for a life that is right so that God’s people may be up to the task ahead and have all they need to accomplish every good work.
verses.Hebrews 4:12: The word of God, you see, is alive and moving; sharper than a double-edged sword; piercing the divide between soul and spirit, joints and marrow; able to judge the thoughts and will of the heart.
verses.Hebrews 11:1: Faith is the assurance of things you have hoped for, the absolute conviction that there are realities you’ve never seen.
verses.1 John 1:9: But if we own up to our sins, God shows that He is faithful and just by forgiving us of our sins and purifying us from the pollution of all the bad things we have done.
